guidance.needsIncomingPath: This point should show where the main flow comes from to make the operation clear.

guidance.decisionNeedsPaths: A decision is clearer when it explicitly shows at least two paths.
guidance.decisionNeedsNamedPaths: Name the decision outputs so each path has an explicit criterion.
guidance.decisionNeedsShortLabels: Use short labels to differentiate each branch of the decision.
guidance.noteNeedsAnchor: Connect the note to the point it explains to avoid loose noise on the canvas.
guidance.endShouldTerminate: Review extra outputs. Strong endings usually terminate the path.
guidance.startHasIncoming: Inputs reaching the start usually indicate an earlier point is still missing from the map.
guidance.multipleOutputsNeedDecision: When a point opens more than one main path, it usually should become a decision.
guidance.addOperationalContext: Add operational context such as owner, area, channel or SLA when it improves the reading.

guidance: Use this only when the flow really needs explicit grouping.

guidance: Use this for notes, risks, exceptions or agreements alongside the flow.
Avoid using this connection to move work between steps.

depends-on.description: Opens a conditional path or dependency that changes continuity.

guidance: Use this for decisions, exceptions and path deviations.

guidance: Use this for the main sequence of the operation.

relates-to.description: Creates a complementary link outside the main sequence.
guidance: Prefer transition, branch or note when a stronger semantic exists.

flow-start.guidanceWhenSparse: Connect the first step to keep the path legible.
flow-start.guidanceWhenConnected: Confirm whether the incoming transitions should point to an earlier step instead.

flow-step.canvasHint: Performs observable work within the operation.
flow-step.summary: Represents an executable activity with a clear responsibility before moving forward.
flow-step.positionEmptyLabel: Still isolated. Show where this activity comes from and where it goes next.
flow-step.positionConnectedLabel: It already occupies a defined operational segment in the flow.
flow-step.guidanceWhenSparse: Connect what comes before and after to avoid operational islands.
flow-step.guidanceWhenConnected: Review whether the next transition is named with the right action.

flow-decision.canvasHint: Evaluates a rule and opens alternate paths.
flow-decision.summary: Concentrates the question, criterion or rule that makes the process branch.
flow-decision.positionEmptyLabel: Not enough paths yet. A decision needs at least one clear output.
flow-decision.positionConnectedLabel: It already influences the path with conditional transitions.
flow-decision.guidanceWhenSparse: Create named outputs to make the alternatives explicit.
flow-decision.guidanceWhenConnected: Use short labels to differentiate each branch of the decision.

flow-end.canvasHint: Consolidates the operational outcome of this flow.
flow-end.summary: Closes the path and communicates the final result or state of the operation.
flow-end.positionEmptyLabel: No previous step connected yet. Show how the flow reaches this point.
flow-end.positionConnectedLabel: Receives the result of previous steps without continuing further.
flow-end.guidanceWhenSparse: Connect the step that delivers this ending.
flow-end.guidanceWhenConnected: Avoid new outgoing transitions to keep the ending terminal and clear.

flow-note.canvasHint: Records risk, exception or context without moving the flow.
flow-note.summary: Documents agreements, alerts or supporting context without turning into another step.
flow-note.positionEmptyLabel: Still loose on the canvas. Attach the note to the segment it explains.
flow-note.positionConnectedLabel: Supports reading the flow without competing with the main sequence.
flow-note.guidanceWhenSparse: Connect the note to the point in the flow it clarifies.
flow-note.guidanceWhenConnected: Use notes for exceptions, SLA, risk or complementary rules.
